description: This file defines a React context provider component named ApplicationProvider that provides a WebApplication instance to its descendants via React Context. It also includes a custom hook useApplication to consume the context, and utilizes MobX for reactivity.

methods.name: useApplication
methods.description: Custom hook that accesses the ApplicationContext to retrieve the WebApplication instance, throwing an error if used outside of the provider.

methods.name: ApplicationProvider
methods.description: React component that provides a WebApplication instance via context to its children, memoized for performance and wrapped with MobX observer.
